sources.text:
Balestrand is a former municipality in the old Sogn og Fjordane county, Norway. The 429-square-kilometre (166 sq mi) municipality existed from 1850 until its dissolution in 2020. The area is now part of Sogndal Municipality in the traditional district of Sogn in Vestland county. The administrative centre was the village of Balestrand. Other villages in the municipality included Ese, Kvamme, Låne, Sæle, Dragsviki, and Vetlefjorden.
The municipality was situated at the confluence of the Fjærlandsfjorden/Esefjorden and the main Sognefjorden. The major industries in the municipality were tourism and farming. Balestrand Municipality became popular early due to the interest of artists, such as Hans Gude, Kjartan Lauritzen, Alfred Heaton Cooper, Hans Dahl, and Johannes Flintoe. Their paintings of the scenery around Balestrand inspired visitors, and Balestrand maintains its connection with art. Other industries include made-to-order kitchen interiors, local apple juice, and Nesseplast which produces industrial plastic. The Norwegian National Road 13 ran through the municipality.

stops.name: Balestrand Municipality
stops.detail: Die Gemeinde lag am Zusammenfluss des Fjærlandsfjord/Esefjord und des Haupt-Sognefjord. Die wichtigsten Industrien in der Gemeinde waren Tourismus und Landwirtschaft. Die Gemeinde Balestrand wurde früh durch das Interesse von Künstlern wie Hans Gude, Kjartan Lauritzen, Alfred Heaton Cooper, Hans Dahl und Johannes Flintoe populär. Ihre Gemälde der Landschaft rund um Balestrand inspirierten die Besucher, und Balestrand behält seine Verbindung zur Kunst bei. Andere Industrien sind maßgeschneiderte Kücheninterieurs, lokaler Apfelsaft und Nesseplast, das Industriekunststoff produziert. Die Norwegische Nationalstraße 13 führte durch die Gemeinde.
